name: Datorama
description_en:
Datorama is the historical name associated with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (MCI). The official Trailhead material describes a marketing data integration, harmonization, visualization and activation platform. Its legacy APIConnect, TotalConnect and LiteConnect paths address API data, file-based data mapping and ad hoc single-file analysis respectively.

The current commercial page distinguishes next-generation Marketing Intelligence (MI) from Marketing Cloud Intelligence+. MI runs natively on Salesforce with Data 360; its prerequisites should not be retroactively assigned to every legacy Datorama deployment. The page explicitly says MCI has no planned EOL, EOS or end of roadmap.
description_zh:
Datorama 是与 Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence（MCI）关联的历史名称。官方 Trailhead 材料描述营销数据接入、统一、可视化与执行平台。其旧体系中的 APIConnect、TotalConnect、LiteConnect 分别处理 API 数据、文件映射和临时单文件分析。

当前商业页面区分新一代 Marketing Intelligence（MI）与 Marketing Cloud Intelligence+。MI 基于 Salesforce 原生平台和 Data 360，不能把它的前置条件倒推给所有旧 Datorama 部署。该页明确表示 MCI 尚无计划中的 EOL、EOS 或路线图终止。

core_features.explanation_en: API and file ingestion are mapped to marketing reporting models before comparison.
core_features.explanation_zh: API 和文件输入先映射到营销报表模型，再比较。

core_features.explanation_en: Trailhead describes Data Canvas, SmartLenses and custom analytical tools in MCI.
core_features.explanation_zh: Trailhead 描述 MCI 的 Data Canvas、SmartLenses 和自定义分析工具。

core_features.name_zh: 区分 MI 与 MCI+ 组合
core_features.explanation_en: Current pricing distinguishes Salesforce-native MI from the broader MCI+ offering.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前定价区分 Salesforce 原生 MI 与更广的 MCI+ 产品组合。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: For MI, the FAQ requires enabling Foundations, provisioning Data 360, connecting sources and assigning access. Organizations without an appropriate Core product need a Cross-Product Admin SKU for platform access. Existing MCI customers should establish their own edition and migration scope rather than assume they must rebuild. Both reviewed offerings are hosted commercial products; no self-hosted software license was verified.
steps.zh: MI 的 FAQ 要求启用 Foundations、配置 Data 360、连接来源并分配权限。没有适用 Core 产品的组织需要 Cross-Product Admin SKU 才能取得平台访问。现有 MCI 客户应核对自己的版本及迁移范围，不能假定必须重建。所读两类产品均为托管商业产品，未确认自托管软件许可。

items.en: This is a candidate for marketing operations teams that must reconcile multiple source schemas and share governed reports. A single advertising platform report may be sufficient for one channel; a general BI tool still requires someone to model marketing data. Validate connector refresh, historical backfills and changed field names with a representative sample. No connector was executed, and retry guarantees, organization-specific data limits and automated activation safeguards were not confirmed. Preserve the distinction between MCI continuity and newer MI capabilities.
items.zh: 需要核对多种来源 schema 并分享受控报表的营销运营团队，可把它列入候选。单渠道可能用广告平台自身报表就足够；通用 BI 工具仍需要有人建模营销数据。应通过代表性样本验证连接器刷新、历史回填及字段改名。本研究未运行连接器，也未确认重试保证、组织专属数据上限或自动执行保护。应继续区分 MCI 延续状态与新 MI 能力。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The current US pricing view lists MI at $10,000 per organization per month and MCI+ at $11,000, both billed annually. MCI+ includes MI. Additional Data 360 usage credits, Tableau licenses or other add-ons may be needed; a sales quote must establish the actual package. These are not old Datorama per-user prices, and no sustained free platform plan or trial duration was established. The page says Premier Support is included in MCI editions while also showing generic support-plan rates; resolve support packaging in the order form.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前美国定价视图列 MI 每组织每月 10,000 美元、MCI+ 11,000 美元，均按年计费，MCI+ 包含 MI。可能另需 Data 360 用量积分、Tableau 许可或其他附加项，应由销售报价明确实际组合。这不是旧 Datorama 的按用户价格，本次未建立持续免费平台方案或试用时长。页面称 MCI 各版包含 Premier Support，又展示通用支持方案费率，应在订单中确认组合。

sections.title_en: Unify spend reports without double counting
sections.title_zh: 统一支出报表并避免重复计算
sections.en: For an illustrative multi-channel campaign report, ingest ad-platform delivery and a file-based spend sheet, map campaign IDs and dates, then reconcile totals before creating a cross-channel dashboard. APIConnect and TotalConnect are documented for different inputs; LiteConnect can serve ad hoc files without the same upfront model design. Editorially, inspect currency, duplicate rows and metric grain first: adding account-level spend to already aggregated campaign spend can double count. A connected dashboard cannot repair an incorrect source definition by itself.
sections.zh: 以跨渠道活动报告为例，可接入广告平台投放数据及文件支出表，映射活动 ID 和日期，核对总额后再建立跨渠道看板。APIConnect 与 TotalConnect 对应不同输入；LiteConnect 可用于无需相同前置模型设计的临时文件。编辑建议先检查币种、重复行与指标粒度：把账户级支出加入已汇总活动支出可能重复计算。连接好的看板本身不能修复错误来源定义。
